app.name: Tablet App for Mac
app.language.note: Non-English text may still be refined.
confirm.scribble_paste: Paste works in your drawing app
confirm.scribble_cut: Cut works in your drawing app
confirm.scribble_select_all: Select all works in your drawing app
confirm.scribble_zoom: Zoom works in your drawing app
startup.toggle: Start automatically when I log in
startup.description: Your tablet only works while Tablet App for Mac is running. If this is off, open Tablet App for Mac each time before using your tablet.
startup.approval_needed: macOS is waiting for your approval: turn Tablet App for Mac on in System Settings › General › Login Items.
startup.unavailable: Start at login isn't available on this Mac. Open the app yourself before using your tablet, or add it in System Settings › General › Login Items.
startup.unavailable_platform: Run at startup isn't available on this platform.
autostart.title: Start Tablet App for Mac automatically when you log in?
autostart.body: Your tablet only works while Tablet App for Mac is running. If you choose Manually, open Tablet App for Mac each time before using your tablet.
autostart.later_hint: You can change this later in Settings › System.
tray.tooltip: Tablet App for Mac. Your tablet works while this is running
tray.tooltip_status: Tablet App for Mac — {status}. Your tablet works while this is running.
tray.quit_warning: Your tablet will stop working until you open Tablet App for Mac again.
save.tip: Save settings so they survive a driver restart (Cmd+S).
save.tip_unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save settings so they survive a driver restart (Cmd+S).
save.dialog.quit_body: Save changes before quitting? If the driver isn't running, they are kept and restored next time you open the app.
save.dialog.unsaved_body: Save your current settings before continuing? Unsaved changes may be lost when the driver restarts or another preset is loaded. Continuing does not undo changes already running on the driver.
home.about_blurb: Tablet App for Mac is a free, artist-friendly tablet app.
home.licence_blurb: Tablet App for Mac is a modified version based on OpenTabletArtist and OpenTabletDriver. OpenTabletArtist is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0); OpenTabletDriver is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0). This program comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY. The full licence texts are in the LICENSES folder and NOTICE file of the download, and the source code is available from the Source code link.
home.not_found_hint: Not found. Double-click to see what to try.
update.donor_thanks: We are grateful to all who donated and keep this project alive.
update.prompt_body: Update now? The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it.
setup.title: Set up Tablet App for Mac
setup.wacom.warning: The Wacom driver is still installed. It can stop this app from using your tablet. Remove it first with Wacom's own uninstaller, then restart your Mac. If you don't have Wacom's uninstaller, use a cleaner such as App Cleaner.
setup.wacom.howto: In Wacom Tablet Utility, under Tablet Software, click Uninstall. This app only removes empty leftover folders, never the full driver.
setup.wacom.no_uninstaller: Wacom's uninstaller isn't on this Mac, so the driver may already be removed. Opening Wacom's removal guide instead.
setup.wacom.leftover: Some files from the Wacom driver are still on this Mac. They're usually harmless. If the tablet misbehaves, see Wacom's removal guide.
setup.wacom.howto_no_utility: Wacom Tablet Utility isn't on this Mac. If only empty leftover folders remain, click Remove leftovers. For a full driver, use Wacom's removal guide or a cleaner such as App Cleaner.
setup.wacom.remove_failed: Couldn't remove some leftovers (needs permission). Use Wacom's removal guide, or a cleaner such as App Cleaner.
setup.pen.header: Let the app read your pen
setup.pen.body: Click the button. In the list that opens, find Tablet App for Mac and turn its switch on. If macOS asks, click Allow.
setup.pen.why: Why: macOS lets an app read a tablet only with Input Monitoring. The app uses it to read your pen, ExpressKeys and Touch Ring.
setup.pen.stale: Is the switch already on? It may be left over from an earlier version. Simply turning it off and on again is not enough. Select Tablet App for Mac, click − to remove it, then click + and add it again from Applications.
setup.pointer.header: Let the pen move the pointer
setup.pointer.body: Click the button. In the list that opens ({pane}), find Tablet App for Mac and turn its switch on, as in the picture.
setup.pointer.why: Why: macOS lets an app move the pointer, click and press keys only with {pane}. The app uses it to turn your pen and buttons into pointer moves, clicks and shortcuts.
setup.pointer.stale: Is the switch already on? It may be left over from an earlier version. Simply turning it off and on again is not enough. Select Tablet App for Mac, click − to remove it, then click + and add it again from Applications.
setup.restart.body: macOS only lets the pen work after the app starts again. Click the button; the app closes and opens again by itself.
setup.done.body: Your pen is ready. Try it in Scribble.
perm.remove_readd_twice: After a new build, remove Tablet App for Mac from the list and add it again from Applications in both places — Input Monitoring and Accessibility (or Device Control and Data Access) — so macOS recognises it. Simply turning the switch off and on is not enough.
tablet.pen.manual_tip_note: Used for every stroke while pressure sensitivity is off.
tablet.pen.test_buttons: Press a pen button to test it.
tablet.pen.movement_absolute_help: The pen maps 1:1 to the screen.
tablet.pen.movement_relative_help: The pointer moves from where it is, by how far the pen moves. No Mac-style speed-up.
tablet.pen.smoother_curves_tip: Adds smooth in-between points so fast curves don't show flat pieces in drawing apps. About 5 ms of extra delay.
tablet.ring.show_hud: Show Touch Ring setting (on-screen mode display)
tablet.ring.about_turns: Clockwise and anticlockwise turns can do different things. So can the centre button.
tablet.ring.about_dial: The ring picture on screen moves when you touch the ring, so you can check that it works.
tablet.ring.about_enable: Turn Touch Ring Off to pause the ring. Your settings are kept.
tablet.ring.note.rotate: Turn the ring to rotate the canvas smoothly (experimental). Works in Photoshop and Affinity. Other apps get this mode's keys instead.
tablet.ring.note.zoom: Turn the ring to zoom in and out smoothly (experimental). Works in Photoshop and Affinity. Other apps get this mode's keys instead.
tablet.ring.note.size: Turn the ring to make the brush bigger or smaller smoothly (experimental). Works in Photoshop only. Other apps get this mode's keys instead.
tablet.ring.note.hardness: Turn the ring to make the brush harder or softer smoothly (experimental). Works in Photoshop only, with round brushes. Other apps get this mode's keys instead.
tablet.ring.note.scroll: Turn the ring to scroll, like a mouse wheel: clockwise scrolls down, anticlockwise scrolls up. Works in every app.
tablet.ring.note.keys: Turning the ring sends the keys below, once every {degrees}°.
tablet.ring.note.nothing: The ring does nothing in this mode, and the centre button skips it.
tablet.ring.setup.rotate: Setup: in Affinity, turn on "Enable canvas rotation with ⌘+scroll wheel" in Settings › Tools. Photoshop needs no setup.
tablet.ring.setup.zoom: Setup: if Photoshop moves the picture up and down instead of zooming, untick "Zoom with Scroll Wheel" in Photoshop's Settings › Tools. Or choose Keyboard shortcut… and use ⌘= and ⌘−.
tablet.ring.setup.size: Setup: in Photoshop, pick a brush tool and turn on "Use Graphics Processor" in Settings › Performance.
tablet.ring.setup.hardness: Setup: in Photoshop, turn on "Vary Round Brush Hardness based on HUD vertical movement" in Settings › Tools. Without it, the ring changes opacity instead.
scribble.pointer_only_note: Pointer-only mode doesn't draw, so you won't see the dynamics above. Pick a pressure Mode to see them.
plugins.dir_unavailable: Plugin directory not available (is the driver connected?).
footer.restored_unsaved: Restored unsaved changes from when the app last closed. They are not saved yet: Save keeps them, Revert to saved drops them.
footer.driver_refreshed: Driver settings refreshed. The driver changed them and you had no unsaved changes, so this page now shows its settings.
footer.driver_disconnected_unsaved: The driver disconnected. Reconnecting reloads its current settings; unsaved changes may be lost.
footer.driver_reconnected_replaced: Reconnected to the driver. Its current settings replaced your earlier unsaved changes.
tablet.pen.shared_curve: Shared with Pen (one curve for tip and eraser).
tablet.eraser.heading: Eraser
tablet.eraser.manual_note: Used for every eraser stroke while pressure sensitivity is off.
tablet.eraser.pressure_shared: Pressure sensitivity is shared with Pen.
tablet.expresskeys.body: ExpressKeys are the buttons on your tablet (not the ones on your pen).
tablet.expresskeys.choose_hint: Click ••• next to a key to choose what it does: a keyboard shortcut, a mouse click or scrolling.
tablet.expresskeys.press_hint: Press a key on your tablet to see which row it is.
tablet.expresskeys.enable_note: Use the All buttons switch to stop every key working, for example if your hand keeps pressing one by accident. Your settings are kept, and the keys work again when you turn it back On.
tablet.expresskeys.per_app: Your key settings are saved for this tablet. Each application can have its own: pick it in the Application row above.
tablet.about.name: Name
tablet.app.add_tip: Add an application with its own ExpressKeys, Touch Ring and pen bindings.
tablet.app.add_body: Choose a running application, or browse for one in the Applications folder. Each listed app can have its own ExpressKeys, Touch Ring and pen bindings. Mapping and pressure stay on All other.
tablet.app.browse_invalid: That does not look like a macOS application (.app).
tablet.app.remove_body: Remove settings for {name}? ExpressKeys and pen bindings for that app go back to All other.
tablet.app.bindings_only_note: This application has its own ExpressKeys, Touch Ring and pen bindings. Mapping and pressure use All other.
update.ready_body: The update is downloaded and checked. Install now? The app will reopen. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it.
update.available_both: Version {version} is available. You can also try Version {beta} (not tested yet).
update.beta_available: You have the newest stable version. Version {beta} is available to try (not tested yet).
update.on_beta: You're using a BETA. You can go back to the stable Version {version} at any time.
update.on_beta_newer: A newer BETA, Version {beta}, is available. Or go back to the stable Version {version}.
update.beta_body: A BETA has new features that are not tested yet, so something may not work. The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. You can go back to the stable version at any time with Check for updates now. Please tell us how it went with Feedback on Home.
update.go_back_body: This replaces the BETA with the stable version. The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it.
update.choose_stable_line: Version {version}: the newest stable version. Recommended.
update.choose_beta_line: Version {beta}: a BETA with new features, not tested yet. Help us test it.
update.choose_go_back_line: Version {version}: the stable version, if the BETA gives you trouble.
update.earlier_heading: Go back to an earlier version
update.earlier_body: Choose the version to go back to. The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it. The earlier version may offer this one again when it checks for updates; choose Not now to stay on it.
update.earlier_none: Couldn't find an earlier version right now. Check the internet connection and try again.
home.perm_reset.body: If the permission switches turn themselves off, macOS is still holding the entries for an older version. Reset them, then add this version again.
home.perm_reset.dmg: Tablet App for Mac is running from the disk image or Downloads. Drag it into Applications and open it from there, or permissions will not stay on.
home.perm_reset.done: Done. Now open System Settings › Privacy & Security. In Input Monitoring and in {pane}, select any old Tablet App for Mac entry and remove it with −, then add this version with + and switch it on. Restart the app afterwards.
home.perm_reset.failed: The reset did not work. Remove the old entries by hand with −, then add this version with +.
tablet.device.add_body: Connect the tablet to your Mac. It appears here by itself. If it doesn't, this app may not know the model yet: open Tablet configs to check for one.
tablet.not_detected.detail: Not detected. Showing this tablet's saved settings.
tablet.not_detected.help: If it is plugged in: check it has power and that its USB cable goes straight into the Mac, not through a hub. Then click Restart driver. Still not found? Send a report and we will look into it.
tablet.device.remove_tip: Forget this tablet and its settings.
tablet.pen.add_body: Bring the new pen close to the tablet. It's added to the Tool row by itself, with its own tip, eraser and side-button settings (a copy of the main pen's to start with).
tablet.pen.per_pen_note: This pen has its own tip, eraser and side-button settings. Tip Feel, pressure, tilt and mapping are shared by all pens.
tablet.pen.remove_body: Remove the settings for "{name}"? It goes back to the main pen's settings. If you use it again, it comes back here with a copy of the main pen's settings.
manual.title: User manual
backup.description: Save all your settings to one file: tablets, pens, presets, applications, calibration and app settings. You can email the file to someone else, or keep it safe for a new Mac. Serial numbers are left out.
backup.auto.title: Automatic backups
backup.auto.description: A backup is made when a new version starts for the first time, and before every import. The last 5 are kept.
backup.preview.title: {file} — made by version {version} on {date}
backup.preview.check: Check the changes below, then choose Apply.
backup.preview.nothing: This file matches your current settings. Nothing would change.
backup.import.done: Settings imported. Your previous settings were backed up first ({file}). Quit and reopen the app to finish.
diag.zip.title: Diagnostic file
diag.zip.description: Makes one zip with a summary, the app and driver logs, your settings, the connected tablets and your mice and keyboards (name, IDs, connection and driver), for a GitHub issue. Serial numbers, Bluetooth addresses and your user name are removed.
diag.report.title: Send diagnostic report to the team?
diag.report.text: The report has serial numbers and your user name removed. Send opens a new GitHub issue with the details filled in and shows the file in Finder: drag it into the issue and press Create. Cancel keeps the file on your Desktop and sends nothing.
diag.report.sent: Opened the GitHub issue page. Drag the file in and press Create to send it.
conflict.process.title: Another tablet driver is running
conflict.process.detail: This program is running now and may grab the tablet at the same time. Quit it or uninstall that driver.
statusled.toggle: Light up the status light when the pen touches
statusled.description: Intuos4 only. The light stays dim and gets bright while the pen touches the tablet, as with the Wacom driver. Off: one steady brightness.
oled.toggle: Show what each ExpressKey does on its screen
oled.description: Intuos4 Medium, Large and Extra Large. Each small screen beside an ExpressKey shows that key's action, as with the Wacom driver. Off: the screens stay dark.
report.menu: Report a problem or send a recommendation…
report.title: Report a problem or send a recommendation
report.text_label: What happened, or what is your idea?
report.email_help: Leave your email so we can help you better in fixing your issue
report.email_hint: Optional · only with Send with file
report.email_ask: Send without your email? We can only reply to you, and help fix your problem, if you leave your email.
report.window_picture: Add this picture of the app window
report.note:
Send with file asks where to save one file with your text, your pictures and the app and driver logs. Then click Open upload page and add this file. The page asks for your name and email (Dropbox's rule) — only the Tablet App for Mac team sees them; no Dropbox account is needed.
Send with GitHub account saves the file on your Desktop and opens a new GitHub issue with your text: drag the file into it and press Create. This needs a free GitHub account.
Serial numbers and your user name are removed from the logs, but pictures are sent as they are: check them first.
report.record.hint: Click Record the problem, make the problem happen with your tablet, then click Stop recording. What the tablet sent goes into the report.
report.record.recording: Recording… messages from the tablet so far: {n}
report.record.done: Recording added to the report: {n} messages from the tablet.
report.record.limit: Recording stopped at the 2-minute limit: {n} messages from the tablet added to the report.
report.howto.2: Make the problem happen 3 to 5 times, a few seconds apart.
report.howto.3: If it is about clicks, click the same windows with your mouse first, then with the pen.
report.howto.5: In one line, write what you expected and what happened instead.
report.howto.6: Click Send with file, then Open upload page, and add the file there.
tablet.pen.double_click_note: How far the pen tip may wobble during a click before it counts as a drag. Off for drawing apps that need every movement.
save.default.tip: Store the current settings as your own default. They survive a restart, and Revert to default brings them back.
save.default.revert_tip: Restore your saved default. If you have not saved one, restores the factory settings.
save.default.revert_tip_no_user: You have not saved your own default yet. This restores the factory settings.
save.default.revert_confirm_body: This replaces the current settings with your saved default (or the factory settings if you have not saved one) and saves them. Unsaved edits will be lost.
save.default.failed_body: The current settings could not be stored as your default. Try again after Save.
save.factory.tip: Reset everything to the original factory defaults. Asks for confirmation first. Your own saved default is kept.
save.factory.confirm_body: Your current settings will be replaced with the factory settings. Your own saved default is kept, so you can still use Revert to default afterwards.
save.revert_tip: Replace live settings with the driver’s saved file, discarding unsaved changes.
save.revert_tip_disabled: Nothing to revert — live settings already match the driver’s saved file.
save.factory.failed_body: Nothing was changed. Try again. If it fails again, restart the driver in Settings › Troubleshooting and try once more.
binding.scroll.pen_tip: Hold the button and move the pen to scroll, like a mouse wheel. The cursor stays still.
binding.scroll.pen_zoom_tip: Hold the button and move the pen up or down to zoom. Uses Option+scroll, like the Touch Ring Zoom mode. Works in Photoshop and Affinity.
binding.scroll.pen_pan_zoom: Move pen to pan and zoom
binding.scroll.pen_pan_zoom_tip: Hold the button and move the pen: sideways to pan, up or down to zoom. Works in Photoshop and Affinity.
binding.scroll.speed_tip: 1–100. Higher is faster. 50 is the middle, same as Pen scroll.
settings.troubleshoot.title: Troubleshooting
settings.troubleshoot.intro: Quick fixes when the tablet stops responding, a setting will not stick, or you need to send a report.
settings.troubleshoot.restart_body: Stops the tablet driver and starts it again. Use this when the pen stops moving or a tablet is not detected.
settings.troubleshoot.diag_body: Saves a zip on your Desktop with logs, settings and tablet info you can attach when asking for help.
settings.troubleshoot.perm_body: Clears this app’s Input Monitoring and Accessibility entries so macOS will ask again.
tablet.expresskeys.key_note: To turn off just one key, click ••• next to it and choose Turn off. A key works only when All buttons and the key are both On.
tablet.ring.about_enable_all: Turn Touch Rings Off to pause every ring, or use each ring's own On/Off. Your settings are kept.
tablet.strip.about_enable: Turn Touch Strip Off to pause the strip. Your settings are kept.
tablet.strip.about_enable_all: Turn Touch Strips Off to pause every strip, or use each strip's own On/Off. Your settings are kept.
radial.title: Radial menu
radial.intro: Press this button to show a round menu with 8 slices around the pen. Tap a slice with the pen tip to use it. The menu stays open, so you can use several slices one after another, and a tap outside it goes to your work. To close it, tap the × in the centre, press the button again or press Esc.
radial.editor_help: Click a slice to choose what it does. Slices you leave empty do nothing when tapped.
radial.label: Name
radial_spot.heading: Radial Menu Settings
radial_spot.none: No pen button opens the radial menu yet
radial.toggle_description: For pen buttons and ExpressKeys set to Radial menu (Change… › Radial menu). Off: those buttons do nothing.
appswitch.description: Leave this off unless tapping another app's window with the pen doesn't switch to that app. You'd see it if the menu at the top of the screen still shows the app you were in. Turning it on can make that first tap up to 1 second slower.
tablet.pen.position_smoothing_note: Steadies wobbly lines, at a little lag. 0 is off, 10 is the strongest.
tablet.pen.hold_keyboard_label: Right click; hold for the keyboard
tablet.pen.hold_keyboard_note: Long press of Pen button 1 opens the Keyboard
radial.centre.edit: Turns on edit mode: then tap a slice to choose what it does.
radial.centre.restore: Asks whether to restore the 8 default slices.
confirm.radial_edit_hint: Edit the slice you tap next
filters.intro: Filters from other OpenTabletDriver plugins, for example Antichatter or Radial Follow smoothing, can calm a shaky pointer. Turn one on to use it with this app. If the pen starts to feel odd, turn it off again. For simple smoothing while the pen touches, try Pen › Position smoothing first.
notablet.title: No tablet yet
notablet.body: Plug in your tablet and it shows up here. Don't have it with you? Choose your model and set everything up now. Your settings are used as soon as the tablet is connected.
home.no_tablets_hint: Connect a tablet and it appears here, or choose your model and set it up now.
choose.title: Choose your tablet
choose.body: Set up your tablet now, even before you plug it in. Your settings are used as soon as it is connected. The model number is on the label on the back of the tablet (for example PTK-440).
choose.search: Search, for example PTK-440 or Wacom
choose.no_driver: The driver isn't running, so the tablet can't be added yet. Start the driver on Home and try again.
choose.unknown: This tablet isn't in the list of supported tablets.
choose.failed: The driver didn't accept the new tablet. Try again, or restart the driver on Home.
choose.not_saved: The tablet was added but couldn't be saved. Press Save on the tablet's page.
offer.text: Your {connected} is connected, but it isn't set up yet. You set up the {chosen} before. Copy its pen and screen mapping settings to the {connected}?
binding.touch.text: Each press of this button turns finger touch on or off, like Wacom's Touch On/Off. The Touch trackpad switch on the tablet's page sets how touch starts.
binding.touch.name: Touch on/off
save.status.unsaved_hint: Your changes work now. Click Save to keep them after a restart.
save.auto.description: Like the Wacom driver: every change is kept at once, also after a restart. Off: changes still work at once, but only Save keeps them.
search.label: Setting search
tablet.about.touch_speed_hint: How far the pointer goes when one finger moves. Higher is faster. 50 is the speed of Version 28.
tablet.about.scroll_momentum_hint: Two-finger scrolling keeps going for a moment after you lift your fingers, then slows to a stop, like a Mac trackpad. Touch the tablet to stop it.
keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.hold_note: A quick press right-clicks. Holding it about half a second opens or closes the keyboard.
keyboard.hold_other: Pen button 1 does something else now (set with Change…). Pick one here to change it.
keyboard.no_menu: No pen button opens the radial menu yet, so there is no slice to put the keyboard on.
keyboard.no_free_slice: Every slice of the radial menu is in use. To put the keyboard on one, first empty a slice: click the radial menu picture on the Pen page.
keyboard.resize_tip: Drag to make the keyboard bigger or smaller
keyboard.section_intro: A small keyboard that floats over your work, so you can type with the pen. Drag its top bar to move it, and its bottom-right corner to make it bigger or smaller.
palette.title: Colour Palette Settings
palette.help: Press the pen button that opens the radial menu twice quickly to show this palette (twice again swaps back). Tap a colour: Photoshop takes it as the brush colour; in other apps it is copied, or pick it with the app's own eyedropper.
palette.solid: The palette is always solid, so the colours you pick are exact.
radial.keyboard_line: Floating keyboard: put it on a slice of this menu, then tap that slice to type with the pen.
radial.keyboard_tab_note: The keyboard's size, transparency and pen button hold are on the Keyboard tab of the Pen page.
palette.restore_prompt: Put the palette's own colours back?
tablet.ring.modes_optional: Optional. Off: the ring uses the rows above. On: the centre button switches between up to 4 modes and shows each one on screen.
binding.media.brightness_tip: Like the Mac's brightness key: changes the screen you last clicked in.
tablet.ring.mode1_only: The centre button doesn't switch modes, so the ring always does what mode 1 is set to.
tablet.ring.n_modes: {count} modes. Press the ring's centre button to switch.
tablet.ring.no_button: This tablet's ring has no button to switch modes.
tablet.ring.no_mode: No mode does anything, so the ring does nothing.
tablet.ring.one_mode: 1 mode. The centre button has nothing to switch.
tablet.ring.plain_kept: This ring was set up in OpenTabletDriver in a way the modes can't show, so it keeps these rows.
